p,p' DDT and p,p'-DDE dissipate rapidly from the surface layer of Philippine soils and are not likely to accumulate in the environment.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the half‐life for the dissipation of DDT in the soil is 173 to 261 days, while the half‐lives for the degradation of p,p'‐DDD and p,p'–DDE were 105 and 151 days.
DDT and DDT‐like insecticides are not accumulating in soils in the Philippines, and the main mechanism of dissipation is degradation to DDE and other products.
